On my last poll, I asked if there was something you may be afraid of doing due to your fear of failing ? ?
.
I fear(ed) "school". Yes! (I said it) Growing up, school has been the one place where I got to feel my best when I succeeded and my worst  when I got a low grade. It was the place where I learned my worth (literally). It was the source of all my anxiety. I let my grades define my worth & mental health. I've had to unlearn measuring my worth by numbers as I got older. Worth in society is measured by so many things that can make you feel insecure. If it's not the weight on the scale, or the size of your waist, its the GPA score, the size of your breasts, your income, your SAT score and the list goes on. SO, if you're reading this, don't let that number define your worth and the worth of others around you. .
.
You're worth more than ANY number baby! .
.

caption:
Sweat pants, hair done, chillin’ with no makeup on 💅🏽✨ [long post alert! 🚨]
---
For the longest time, I’ve been wanting to try #SenegaleseTwists but there was ALWAYS an excuse... “I don’t have time, I work in Corporate America, It takes too long, etc.” Well, I finally decided to #justdoit! ✔️ (see what I did there 😉)
---
I used 4 packs of X Pressions (color 1B). I had been watching a few helpful YT tutorials. This was my 1st time EVER using weave, so this is MAJOR for me y’all! Never thought I’d be saying this, but I’m no longer a weave virgin! 😂 But don’t get it twisted! ☝🏽 My hair is damn near the length of these twists, so I had to go long. 😏 I only needed weave bc my hair is fine/thin.
---
My intentions were to film my experience, but whew chile! 🤦🏽‍♀️ It took freakin’ FOREVER! I started around 11am yesterday + didn’t finish until 2:30am this morning 😩, with breaks of course! Much respect to those who do this on the regular, bc honey I canNOT! 🙅🏽‍♀️ Idk if I’ll be doing this again anytime soon, but I def ❤️ the turnout. I admit there were times I wanted to cry + quit bc of how long it was taking me. I was hella tired y’all 😫 but my goal was to get it done so I could be able to play with 3J today + cook dinner tonight for my hubby.
---
I say all this to say, DON’T GIVE UP! Whatever you’re trying to achieve in your #naturalhairjourney, keep going + keep trying! 💚 It wasn’t easy, but I did it + I’m super proud of myself for pushing thru. ☺️ If you’re bored with your hair, it’s okay to experiment + switch things up every now and then. So that hairstyle you wanna try, go for it! That haircut you’ve been putting off, stop waiting! Whether you wanna big chop, grow your hair, color it, or just simply try something new, do it! I remember being told my hair was too long for this #protectivestyle, but I’m so glad I did it anyway. 💁🏽‍♀️
---

.

caption: September is SPINAL CORD INJURY AWARENESS Month & I feel it is my duty to share my thoughts with you. Firstly, anyone can suffer an SCI...I was a healthy, fit, fifteen year old yet I couldn’t control the fact that the car I was in crashed snapping my neck. You could be walking around one minute & the next trip and fall wrong resulting in paralysis. Therefore, I want to just say please appreciate what you’ve got, the little things mean more than you’ll ever know 💕 I want to take this down another road...just because I am paralysed doesn’t make me any less of a woman so posting photos like this actually empower me. You would find it hard to believe I once wouldn’t let people take my photo & hated my appearance...I’ve learnt to embrace who I am. Paralysed people are just like you but with lots of other struggles, we have a voice, we have dreams & desires. Life can be hard but life DOESN’T stop because of this injury. I have such a lust for life 🦋 our bodies have been through so much yet carry on and help us experience this beautifully bizarre thing called life...✨we are all more than just our physical body. We are a soul 🦋

caption:
Someone asked me “do you actually like the extensions you do or do you just get them to promote your business”.... .................
At first I took it so personal and I was so genuinely mad that someone in this industry would ask me that... but then I thought about it and I realized that there are so many people in the beauty industry who just say they “love” whatever they have to use because that’s what the salon uses that they work for.. (I’ve been there.. you feel like you have no other choice, you don’t want to loose your job and for me my first salon job) ..................
I work for myself.. I get to do whatever I want, whenever I want to.. Being my own boss has taught me to stand up for the things I love and believe in and when I don’t believe in those products anymore because their formulas or their products have diminished.. I can leave them behind as I continue forward using new brands, products, color lines etc... ....................
For me... that’s the best part about being my own boss, no one can tell or influence me on what to believe in, it’s my choice.. ....................
So to answer that woman’s question.. the only reason I do these extensions is because I personally love them on myself and I choose to find clients who it works with their hair also! With that being said down the road extensions evolve and I will evolve with it.. I won’t be “changing my mind” I will be growing and adapting with the industry! No extension is for everyone, nothing in life is.. ...................

@elfcosmetics beauty shield magnetic mask kit, ⠀
@promise.cosmetics Liquick Multi-Effect Liquid Mud Mask.⠀

caption:
I’m all for doing whatever makes you happy, and for natural tweaks ;)⁣
⁣
my doctor @drgerstmannyc gives me the exact results I want every single time! Here is a before and after of my latest Botox and juvederm treatment⁣
⁣
I suffer from TMJ (Temporomandibular joint dysfunction) which causes a lot of tension in my jaw, pain in my ears, discomfort while eating and sometimes even talking/yawning and I’ve found that the best treatment is Botox in the jaw by a DOCTOR! It kicks in fully about a week or two after and my jaw not only looks sharper, I am also able to function normally without the constant feeling of a locked jaw. I’ve been to oral surgeons, dentists, acupuncturists and I’ve found that the Botox placed correctly gives the most relief. I plan on making a full video on it and perhaps including my doctors explanation as to why it helps me out so much. ⁣
⁣
I also get my lips done with Dr.Gerstman because I’m obsessed with natural looking results and she delivers every single time! I mainly get my upper lip filled to match my naturally plump bottom - but also to help me with hydration. My lips naturally have a bunch of lines which can make them look dry (esp with those bomb matte fall liquid lippies) and the filler gives them a smooth appearance. I love my lip shape, so I’m never looking to change them... just enhance them ;) in the after photo you can see it’s not a drastic change but I’ll upload a photo of my 1st before picture of my lips on ig story so that you can see the true difference! I hated smiling because my upper lip would disappear lol thanx genessss haha but now I’m super confident with my lips because nobody could ever guess that they’re tweaked ;) ⁣
⁣
ps the makeup was removed in the after so that’s why it looks lighter there ( I try not to tan my face as much) whenever I’m in New York, @drgerstmannyc is definitely a must stop for me 💕

caption:
Si alguien me hubiese dicho hace cinco años que el viernes iba a estar firmando mi propio libro para tanta gente que en cinco horas solo tendría tiempo para levantarme del sitio una vez para ir al baño mi cara habría sido un enrome “vale, sí, lo que tú digas”. Pero, entonces, el pasado viernes, más de trescientas bonicas hicísteis cola durante horas para saludarme aunque fueran solo unos segundos, y la frase que más escuché fue “es la primera vez que hago esto, imagínate”. Yo me sonreía por dentro, pensando “madre mía, bonica, yo también” y quería quedarme con cada cara, cada nombre, cada historia vuestra. Porque vosotras estáis cansadas de verme a mí, pero para mí veros a vosotras es totalmente nuevo, y el cariño que me llevé aquella noche a casa fue tanto que he tenido que esperar a escribir esto un lunes para asimilarlo. Gracias por venir, por vuestra paciencia inagotable, por vuestras sonrisas, abrazos, vuestras palabras de apoyo, regalos y cartas. No podía dejar de reírme cada vez que, después de tres horas, alguna de vosotras me decíais: “¡madre mía, debes de estar cansadísima ya!” y yo (os lo prometo) pensaba: “pero cómo voy a estar cansada yo, si estoy aquí sentadita mientras vosotras hacéis cola de pie al sol durante más de dos horas”. Y aún así, en vez de quejaros por eso, os preocupaba más cómo tenía la muñeca y si había bebido el agua suficiente. Sois INSUPERABLES, os lo digo ya. Siempre he pensado que, en Youtube, uno atrae a gente que refleja el “espíritu” de su contenido y, algo debo de estar haciendo bien, porque el pasado viernes vi una familia de bonicas alegres, cariñosas, educadas, respetuosas, positivas con la vida, luchadoras y fuertes. 
Gracias, por todo, siempre.

caption: Buonasera amiche e amici, come state? Mi scuso in anticipo per questo post, perché potrebbe sembrare malinconico, ma siccome sapete che non riesco a fingere di sentirmi in un modo quando mi sento in un altro, vi scrivo queste parole. Oggi è stato proprio UN Lunedì, con la L maiuscola. Purtroppo non è stata una bella giornata, sono stata piuttosto triste, pensierosa e corrucciata. Complice il fatto che non ho dormito bene, complice il tempaccio che oggi ha regnato sul cielo di Roma, complici un po’ di brutti pensieri che si sono concentrati tutti insieme. Insomma, è stata una giornata grigia. Tutto sommato io sto molto meglio rispetto ad un anno fa, ma non posso nascondervi che, ahimè, molte cose ancora non si sono sistemate. caption:
HOW TO GO FROM
DAMAGED CURLS --> HEALTHY CURLS 
My most frequently asked question is:
How can I bring my curls back from all this damage? Let me help you! 
But first I'll tell you how I damaged my curls. From a young age, I use to relax my hair. I would would blow dry at least once a week and flat iron almost everyday to get my hair straight. It wasn't til about 2012-2013 that I really became dedicated to taking care of my hair and I "went natural". So here's what helped me get my curls back!!! 👇

#1. I obviously stopped getting relaxers. So make sure to stop any harsh chemicals. (Relaxers, hair dyes, keratin, bleach, perms...etc.) ❤

#2. I can't stress this enough you have to STOP applying heat to your hair. *drops the flat iron* If you really want to get your curls back you NEED to stay away from heat. So, throw away, sell or donate any heating tools you have at home. (That's what I did so I wouldn't be tempted 😩😂) ❤  #3. Cut your damage off ✂️
If you're too afraid to do a big chop, cut it gradually. But you MUST cut it off. Stop holding on girl. All this cutting will pay off at the end. 🙌 ❤

#4. Invest in great products. There are two major curly hair companies that saved my life in my journey and they were @devacurl @sheamoisture. @mydevacurl has AMAZING kits that you can buy with everything you need. @sheamoisture has a great selection of products that can help you with any specific problems (low porosity, high porosity, dry hair etc..) whatever you buy make sure to read the label in the back your products should NOT contain any Sulfates, Parabens or Silicones (Those things are not curly hair friendly) ❤

#5. STAY FOCUSED. BE CONSISTENT! 
Change doesn't come overnight. But, if you really want to bring your damaged hair back to, big and healthy curls, you must stay focused. Everyday. Also, try to  follow a healthy eating regime. You'd be surprised how much of a change that has on your hair AND nails too 💁‍♀️. So stay hydrated, eat right, stay focused and be consistent! *

caption:
Me encantó esta reflexión.. YA NO LO QUIERAS TANTO ¿Cuántas veces has sentido que no te quiere y que no te merece pero ahí sigues?

Ya no lo quieras tanto, no derrames tanto llanto porque una flor como tú no se puede estar secando. No permitas que su indiferencia te arruine la existencia. 
Sé que tú lo quieres y crees necesitarlo para estar bien, sé que piensas que vas a morir si lo dejas. 
Sé que lloras noche tras noche ahogando tu llanto contra el cojín. Sé que te preguntas qué es lo malo en ti, porqué no te quiere, porqué te ignora y te trata como un maniquí. Te preguntas si tiene otra o si las demás mujeres son mejor que tú. 
Ya no lo quieras tanto...
No permitas que tu sonrisa dependa de sus mensajes que dan la impresión de ser mendigados. 
No dejes que te lastime con caricias vacías. No dejes que te dé sexo y que te haga sentir que no mereces más que eso; una cogida fría, donde no hay besos y ni siquiera te ve a la cara por cobardía. No permitas que te siga dejando vacía mientras el llena su ego y su patética hombría. 
Ya no lo quieras tanto, mujer y quiérete más a ti. 
Sé que te cuesta observarte al espejo porque lo que te ha dicho ha dejado tu autoestima por los suelos. 
Sé que ya no te arreglas, que no te vistes, bailas ni ríes como antes.

Sé que poco a poco te estás perdiendo y lo sabes. Sin embargo, no tienes el valor para alejarte de aquello que tanto daño te hace. 
Deja que él se ahogue en su veneno, toma todas tus fuerzas y vete. 
Ya no lo quieras tanto, invierte ese querer hacia ti, te aseguro que después de eso, te evitarás tanto llanto.

Desempolva esas alas, pontelas y vuela lejos que allá en lo alto nadie podrá hacerte daño. -Desconocido

It moisturizes without looking shiny or compromising the overall matte look. Win, win. ⚡️

caption:
What comes to mind when you see the variables of our hair? Do you see the potential and/or the time? I believe the secret ingredient to its outcome is respect; because hair knows when you care. It knows when you’re demanding an outcome but haven’t nourished or prepared its foundation. Life knows this too. 
This pic says , if you’re all about haste , Do Not Touch. 
I was in the middle of a style prep and had to capture this moment of irony, gravity contradictions and beauty. As I studied it, I felt humbled to what our hair has taught me about so many things in life. So many real life parallels. A daily example of how one approaches the best  of complexities with care and respect- B E F O R E we build upon it. 
Often times, a stylist will reach out to me to ask “what can I do to get to where you are” and I tell them “care and respect” with ‘where you are’, ‘with what you have’, ‘with whom you touch’ .” Sometimes my words disappoints them; for some really desire “shortcuts” not advice. 
Remember that hair and life is sacred before it’s social. 🌸#oneLove #pekelarileyonhair

So a lot of you don’t know how important writing music is to me. It’s the most important creative thing I do and the thing that I am gifted to do. I love weaving complex rhythms and obscure harmonies. I don’t feel more at peace, more whole, doing anything, than when I am composing music.
-
I wrote this poem a long time ago, to a melody I also wrote a long time ago (a melody that’s been in my head for years). It’s actually the melody I ascribe to my beloved sister, @efiknicky. I wrote this towards the end of middle school lol, and I’m more of a scholarly writer (not a poet) but I hope you enjoy it anyway.
-
My heart has seen the darkness,
like that of the night sky.
The pain seems never ending,
sometimes I wonder why.

Yet even through this darkness,
I see the lighted path,
that leads me to my happiness
away from early death.

Not death in physical sense,
but the death that takes much more;
the death of who I am,
the death that closed the door.

The door that is my heart,
the darkness locked inside,
shall trap me in myself,
giving no place to hide. - me, circa 2007

Parece que a @bioextratus adivinhou meus pensamentos! 🤤 Nós, que somos adeptas de coloração e tonalizante precisamos de cuidado redobrado com os fios, pois eles sofrem com as agressões químicas da oxigenada. E pensando nisso a @bioextratusparaamapa desenvolveu a linha Pós Química que promete restaurar e devolver, brilho e balanço dos cabelos danificados. OLHA SÓ:
.
✔DO QUE SE TRATA?
É uma linha que trata os danos responsáveis pelo ressecamento, opacidade e porosidade dos fios.
.
✔QUEM PODE USAR?
É indicada para quem está com os fios danificados por química.
.
✔O QUE ELA PROMETE?limpeza saudável, nutrição intensa, reparação profunda dos danos, restaura o cabelo quimicamente danificado.
.
✔COMO ELA AGE?
A linha Pós-Química possui 3 ativos principais que agem no cabelo da seguinte forma:
.
🔹Abacate: é muito rico em ácido graxos e possui alta concentração de vitamina E, poderoso antioxidante, que hidrata, repara e protege os fios. O abacate também tem aminoácidos e seu óleo é hidrorreparador.
.
🔹Jojoba: é considerada uma ceramida vegetal porque tem uma estrutura química muito similar ao manto hidrolipídico da pele. Isso significa que a pele reconhece esse óleo e o absorve de forma rápida, sem deixar oleosidade. Por normalizar a produção natural de óleo do couro cabeludo, é considerada biomimético. A jojoba é rapidamente absorvida e hidrata sem deixar residual oleoso. Este ativo contribui para um tratamento hidratante, reparador e protetor dos fios
.
🔹Óleo de palma: extraído de uma amêndoa do dendezeiro, este ativo é conhecido como azeite de dendê. Ele tem alto teor de vitaminas e é rico em ácidos graxos, como ômega 6 e 9. O óleo de palma potencializa a hidratação dos fios.
.

Don't get discouraged if it doesn't go the way you want or if you feel like you can't get a good picture practise means that as well as improving makeup skills you will improve your ability to capture them in a photo so don't give up! If you give up you won't be able to look back and realise how far you've come.

caption:
✨Reseña del día✨ 
Si me siguen por stories sabrán que hace varias semanas vengo probando la base Super Stay 24 horas de Maybelline, viene con factor de protección solar de 15, contiene 30 ml y viene en una botellita de vidrio. 
La base es una de las mejores que probé en éste último tiempo (si, le gana a muchas de gama alta). Tiene una cobertura media-alta, pero no queda pesada en la piel. Deja un acabado matte, aunque si tienen piel grasa les recomiendo que de todas formas la sellen con polvo, porque a lo largo del día puede llegar a sacar un poco de brillo. Se funde con la piel de una manera increíble. En mi caso, al tener piel normal a seca, tengo que hidratar bien mi rostro antes de aplicarla, porque si no lo hago puede llegar a resaltar un poco las zonas secas de mi piel. Pero nada que una buena hidratante o un buen primer no pueda solucionar. 
La duración es muy buena, obviamente no la tuve puesta por 24 horas, pero sí la he llevado en la piel por más de 10 horas, y si bien no se veía como recién aplicada, la cobertura todavía estaba y sólo me había sacado un poquito de brillo en la zona T. 
Amé esta base, de hecho, se convirtió en una de mis favoritas. Sólo le encuentro dos inconvenientes: el primero es, como siempre, la gama de colores. Hay muy pocos colores para elegir, y la mayoría tienden al rosado (al menos los que yo ví en la farmacia donde la compré). El tono que uso yo es el Classic Ivory, y me queda un poquito rosado. Y el otro gran inconveniente que encontré es que no tiene con ningún tipo de dosificador, por lo que sacar el producto del frasco se hace difícil. Éste punto quería resaltarlo porque particularmente me molesta bastante que los productos no vengan con un pump o dosificados. De todas formas, ésta base es tan linda que se lo perdono 💖😊

caption:
Capítulo 3: Los negativos (Puedes encontrar la historia en: #rufiembarazo)

Pues nos pusimos manos a la obra, disfrutando de cada momento... Y es cuando empecé a fijarme en cada pequeña señal de mi cuerpo, porque sabía que en cualquier momento podía quedarme embarazada.

Y aquí lo más divertido, ilusos de nosotros creíamos que cualquier día podíamos conseguirlo, no teníamos ni idea de que en la mujer solo hay 6 días fértiles al mes, y que si no lo haces en esos días, o un par antes (contando que el esperma puede vivir dentro nuestro unos 3 días...) es imposible quedarse embarazada.

Ahí me di cuenta que la educación sexual de nuestra época fue un poco deprimente 😅

Total, cada mujer es un mundo, y cada una tiene unos síntomas diferentes tanto para la ovulación, como para la regla, como para el embarazo... (La verdad un mundo que me empieza a fascinar y del que me encantaría aprender, porque me parece súper interesante). Empiezo a notar síntomas de embarazo cada mes, y asustada de si será que si o será que no corto la actividad sexual por esos días por miedo/desconocimiento de que le pueda pasar algo al bebé.

No es hasta después de unos meses que descubro que esos síntomas corresponden a mi ovulación, que al fijarme más en todo me doy cuenta que me duelen los ovarios y se me hinchan los pechos por esos días... Así que estuvimos haciendo el canelo una buena temporada... pero no pasa nada, ahora sé reconocerla tengo un as en la manga, y seguimos a por ello... Cabe destacar, que cada test negativo es un jarro de agua fría, porque te "emparanoyas" con que tienes todos los síntomas, te lo crees, y esperas la rayita con todas tus ansias y te encuentras un blanco nuclear que te devuelve a la realidad. 
Te caes, pero te levantas, con más fuerza, porque este mes lo conseguiremos, una nueva oportunidad, recargas fuerzas y tiras para delante. 
La actitud es muy importante, y no en este tema, en todos los de vuestra vida, por eso buscad el lado bueno y darle la vuelta, y todo cambiará... Hair Savior 💜

I've noticed I don't really talk a lot about hair products and o think I should given that I've gone through plenty of hair horror stories and I'm sure I could share a few good tips with y'all.

Here's one of my favorite products, the @alternahaircare Caviar CC cream. Look, I love trying new stuff but when it comes to hair I stick to what I know works for me. I've been using this baby since like 2013. I've had a ton of different hair colors since then, I was even a little unicorn a few years ago and this hair cream keeps my hair not only styled but protected. 
The Caviar CC cream claims to have 10 benefits and I can assure you, it does it all. When I first started using it, I was applying from mid to ends and my hair looked great but then  when my hair was pink I noticed the color was fading on top and not where I applied the cream and I was really impressed, that was like 3 years ago lol but since then I use it all over my hair.

It is indeed a multitasking leave in conditioner that will provide moisture, strength, smoothness, heat protection, among other things. I always make sure I'm well stocked on this baby and whenever Sephora offers the deluxe 100pta sample I make sure to get a few just in case I need it on the go. I've tried the shampoo and conditioner of this line as well and it worked pretty good.

One of my most signiﬁcant milestones in my transition was my legal name change to Maya. It was such a nerve-wracking, exciting, and ultimately surreal experience to go through a name change to better match my gender identity. I came back to my third year of university in the fall of 2015 and all of my peers had made the effort to call me by my new name. I had never felt such support and camaraderie in my life. In 2009, TD established Workplace Gender Transition Guidelines in North America. That was before I even knew I was transgender! I think it is vital that people are educated on the experiences of trans people so that we can have a greater understanding of the human experience and make sure that customers, clients, and employees feel more safe and welcome. It is so important for trans people to feel loved and acknowledged by the world around them—that is the power of inclusivity. When I ﬁnally received my new drivers license in the mail I was overjoyed. The strings binding me to my old name, and the reminder of the life I left behind, loosened and fell away. #ForeverProud

caption: It has become increasingly difficult to find beauty products that truly feel “new.” There’s nothing wrong with this- we know what we like, textures are tried and tested and the most effective ingredients feel age old- but it does make it all the more exciting to find a product that really is unlike anything in its category. @christopherobinparis’ Cleansing Volumising Paste is a shampoo without competitors. In your hands, it feels like a hybrid paste/scrub- the density and tack of a paste with the physical granules of a scrub. You need to really work it into your roots to prevent it from just sitting on top of your hair, but once it makes contact with water it builds to a creamy, foaming lather. I’ve been using it for a few months and rarely follow it up with conditioner (I became hooked on Aquis last year and have semi-permanently adopted their “no conditioning” method), instead applying the brand’s Hair Cream to damp ends. Hair has more volume and feels bouncier than ever before. Am very, very impressed. #notsponsoredjustgood and I believe in Aus you can get this via both Adore Beauty and Sephora.

caption: Social media is so weird sometimes. I look through my explore page and my feed and feel like I’m the only one who doesn’t have the perfect body or the perfect face, and I forget that everyone probably feels the same way I do behind the screen. We all live behind these edited lives and it is just so weird to me when I take a step back and look at it. I try my hardest to stay real with you guys and be honest, but a lot of the time I catch myself doing the same thing, pretending to be perfect. I don’t want to be judged, I don’t want to be hated, I don’t want people to think I’m ugly or fake. I must have perfect skin, my editing has to be on point, my lighting has to be perfect. And then I take a minute and think about what I’m doing and remember that most of those things really do not matter. I have so many positives in my life, and you guys are a big part of that. I owe it to you to be real all of the time so you know that no matter what body type you are or how your skin looks in that moment or how much money you have in your bank account, the only thing that matters is your happiness and well being! You are beautiful and worthy. Let go of toxic relationships, work hard on your goals, eat healthy, drink a lot of water, hang out with your friends, meditate if you have to. No matter what you see on your Instagram or Twitter, no one is perfect and that is a fact. I love you all so much and hope you remember these things when you are having a rough day/week/year.

Happy Tuesday loves! let's talk hair💁🏾
_

Did you know cutting your hair does not make it grow any faster? Let me explain!
_
Hair can only be preserved.The growth of our Hair only happens at the scalp level and once it grows out it is considered "dead". It's the blood capillaries surrounding the hair follicles that cause it to grow as well as supply the adequate nutrients the hair needs.
Additionally,cutting our hair only gets rid of damaged ends which gives it a fuller look and prevents its breakage. 
_
Stay naturally beautiful and have a great day Queens 👸🏾 .

Thoughts on my @fourthraybeauty products so far... 🍉Watermelon seed Oil: I haven't used this oil a ton yet, it's supposed to help control sebum production but I don't actually have a lot of issues with oily skin so I'll probably use this more in the summer. I feel like this oil absorbs super quick so I like a slower absorbing oil like the the Skin Hero Oil instead. .
🍵 Matcha Milk: The smell is a little odd to me but I love the way this booster feels on my skin. It's really nice as an extra hydrator so I've been applying it in the mornings before my moisturizer. .
Fresh AF milk: this smells so refreshing! I love this after my moisturizer to lock in all my skincare products. No idea if it's actually doing that but it feels nice and the smell makes me happy.
.
Mellow Milk: I've been using this mist straight out of the shower to keep my skin moist! I hate that feeling after washing your face of tight dry skin and the mellow milk mist is extra hydrating and soothing.
.

.

.

caption:
For many years, I wasn’t able to hold a “fast food” burger like this..
All thanks to my lifestyle choices and the fact that I can’t have dairy #nodairy now I’m no #vegan BUT I opt out and swing closer to the more #plantbased #paleo (with the exception of having #chicken and #fish for that #omega and #protein when I do really crave it) way of eating as I find that it benefits me with my life, my body, and caters to my unfortunate sickness being #multiplesclerosis
So I’m saying that, I was never able to had a massive #cheesy #burger like this with its juices (and I kid you not) dripping down my fingers and hand while biting into my very first bite 🤤 #cravings #foodporn
BUT NOW GALS TIMES ARE CHANGING
You have all sorts of fast food chains that are coming up with more ways and more healthy menu items to attract a customer base which like me eats a certain special way - a pat on the back for the ones who do, we appreciate you 😂-
I’m saying that I walked into @hungryjacksau thinking I’ll grab a #grilledchickensalad of some sort and was actually so excited when I saw a massive poster in front of my eyes advertising the “ #vegancheese “ #whopper 🤤🤤🤤
SISTAS THIS WAS THE MOST AMAZING BURGER I HAVE BITTEN INTO IN SUCH A LONG TIME - ITS BEEN SEVEN WHOLE FRICKEN YEARS LONG!
I’m not saying this type of eating is the way to go, hang there for a sec 🤚🏼 No it isn’t.
But I live by the moto #listentoyourbody and that day I stuffed my face with this beauty was a day where I was on the go non stop, my whole day was basically workout (you gals probably noticed - hey hellow I moved again🙋🏻‍♀️) and I was carrying boxes upon boxes so basically I actually deserved this bad boy - indulge once in a while. Learn to treat yourself and not feel guilty about it. Don’t deprive yourself, it’s very selfish. I know this is going to sound so #cliche but you only live once, so live it to the fullest in every possible way #yolo

Jetzt erzähle ich euch nochmal was zur Story mit meiner gerissenen Einkaufstüte heute:
Ich stand an der Kasse vom Supermarkt und entschied mich, wieder eine Papiertüte mitzunehmen. Jutebeutel hatte ich im Auto vergessen. Ich denke mir immer: so Papiertüten können ja wahnsinnig stabil sein. Was mir die heutige aber leider nicht bewiesen hat. Im Eingang des Supermarktes passierte es. Meine Tüte riss. Sofort sind mir tausend Gedanken durch den Kopf geschossen: oh Gott, alles rausgefallen, wie bekomm ich das alles ins Auto?? OH Nein ! Die Leute gucken. Owei, ich bin auch noch ungeschminkt, ich stehe voll im Mittelpunkt und keiner hilft. Hatte auf einmal mega die Panik. 
Verloren im Mittelpunkt von starrenden Augen, herumliegenden Lebensmitteln und meinen Geschichten im Kopf, das totale Chaos. 
Und dann dachte ich mir: Laura! Du kannst JETZT den Schalter umlegen! Was ist passiert? Deine Tüte ist geplatzt. Ja und? Es ist ne Tüte. Und 1 Minute Arbeit, dass in die neuen zu packen. Es ist alles gut. Und so viele schauen doch gar nicht. Und dann kam schon die nette Dame mit 2 neuen Tüten. 
Dann setzte ich mich in die Hocke und zelebrierte noch das Zusammenpacken der Lebensmittel, weil es überhaupt nicht schlimm ist. Das einzig "Schlimme" war die Geschichte in meinem Kopf. 
Und die kannst auch, du jeder Zeit ändern. 
Das war meine Kopfgeschichte. Die Sache mit gerissenen Tüten. Halb so wild. Solltest du mich das nächste Mal mit Lebensmitteln aufm Boden sehen, lad ich dich auch gerne ein, zu helfen. 🖤

caption:
So lately I’ve been getting a lot of messages basically shamming me for taking antidepressants, and telling me that depression isn’t real, and that I just have to “think positive thoughts”. And this is the reason to why so many people don’t open up about their mental issues! Mental illnesses are just as valid as any other kind of illness. And people are so ignorant and judgmental every time someone tries to open up and talk about their issues! 
I suffer from a lot of anxiety and depression, and it appears in periods. I have periods where I barley notice my depression and I have periods where it’s fucking unbearable and I just want to die all the time, and my anxiety is just constantly there so I can’t function normally. That’s why I’ve been going to my doctor to try and get help, so I won’t be suicidal or tormented with anxiety. 
It’s really difficult to see a psychiatrist in Norway unless you have the money for a private one (which I don’t have). So taking antidepressants was the only solution for me at this moment. It’s not a permanent solution, but it’s helping me live a almost normal life until I can see a professional. 
And also I choose to be open about my mental health because I personally find it helpful when people are open, and because I want it to be a normal thing to talk about! People shouldn’t feel ashamed or be scared to seek help. 
And I really hope the fact that I’m open about these issues will help people feel less alone, cause you’re not alone 
#mentalhealthawareness

caption: The aforementioned base combo. Before anyone starts mouthing off YES these are expensive and of course nothing in beauty is a MUST. If you love spending your money on beauty products then I absolutely suggest considering these as in this instance (not always!) I feel you are getting what you pay for in terms of quality. I was first introduced to Creme De La Mer by a makeup artist many years ago and every @lamer product I've tried since has wowed me (they're indulgent but very beautiful on the skin) but the Luminous Cushion Foundation has been my first experience with their colour cosmetics. This is hands down the best cushion foundation I've used and easily one of the most beautiful foundations I've ever worn. Coverage is buildable but feels weightless, satin finish with the most natural luminosity to it (serious "your skin but better" stuff) and it has not budged on any of the occasions I've worn it. I've been using it with the @tatcha Silk Canvas as a primer- it has an amazing blurring effect on the skin, the texture is unlike anything I've felt and it really allows you to get greater density out of any colour cosmetics you apply over it. I've also been setting with the @tatcha Dewy Skin Mist which is heaven in a bottle. No shimmer, no shine, just adds DEW and staying power to whatever you mist it over. I'm loving these three together but of course for the sake of reviewing have tried them on their own and they all perform equally well solo. I think I've covered it all here but sing out if I haven't. Might do some proper @glow.journal stories on my top picks from both brands so stay tuned. Again, #notsponsoredjustgood

If the harsh winter has taken a toll on you and worn your lips out, you'll want to keep reading!
•

•

•
It seems to be only available online and it retails for $42. It's cruelty free and vegan. It definitely is on the pricier side but it's worth it, especially during this time of the year.

No drinking and driving. Much love.
XO, Dina.

✨Reseña del día ✨. Hace unas semanas que vengo probando estos dos productos que @fashionvictimargentina tan amablemente me prestó para que testeara. Hablemos del rubor. El color puede parecer un poco chocante, un rosa llamativo con subtono azulado, digamos que no todos nos inclinaríamos a comprar un rubor de este color. Lo que hace a este producto tan especial, es que posee una tecnología llamada "Fresh Colour Reveal", que reacciona y cambia de color de acuerdo al ph de la piel. ¿suena raro?, bueno, comprobé que es así. A cada persona le queda diferente, pero siempre queda en la gama de los rosados. En mi caso, me queda un rosadito no dan llamativo como se ve en el producto. Me sorprendió muchísimo la duración del mismo en la piel, se bancó toda una jornada laboral (que en mi caso dura unas 10 horas) intacto.
En cuanto al bronzer, no lo entendí del todo. Se supone que es un bronzer pero en mi piel queda naranjita y con brillos (muchos). No es un color que yo usaría para broncear la piel, pero si lo usé como rubor y deja la piel satinada y con un color bellísimo. 
Creo que ni vale la pena que hable del packaging, porque ya todos sabemos que Dior es lujo puro. ¿Probaron algun otro producto de la marca?, ¿Alguno para recomendarme?

caption:
Una consulta que me suelen hacer seguido, sobre todo cuando muestro parte de mi colección de maquillaje, es sobre los vencimientos y la duración de los productos. Un tema que preocupa mucho, sobre todo cuando tenemos una colección extensa, o quizás algunos productos que amamos pero que tenemos hace mucho tiempo. 
Todos los productos en su packaging tienen un simbolo de un tarrito con un número (pueden ver el ejemplo en la segunda foto). Por ley, las marcas deben estipular la cantidad de meses en que el producto se encuentra en condiciones de ser usado sin riesgo. En el caso de los labiales siempre es de 12 a 24 meses, en cambio, las máscara de pestañas sólo duran unos 3 meses en buenas condiciones. 
Particularmente nunca le presto demasiada atención. Exceptuando las máscaras de pestañas, que suelo usarlas como mucho unos 4 meses (porque me ha pasado de no hacerlo, y terminar con alguna infección en los ojos), al resto de mis productos no suelo hacerle caso a la duración marcada. No digo que sea lo correcto, pero es la verdad. 
Si presto mucha atención a los aromas,por ejemplo, si noto que un labial no huele como antes, o si su textura cambió, lo tiro. Con las bases lo mismo, si su fórmula esta diferente, o tiene un olor distinto, a la basura. Creo que las sombras o los productos en polvo son los que más tipo duran, y más dificil es darse cuenta si están en malas condiciones. Tengo paletas de sombras que forman parte de mi colección hace años  y que no pienso tirar nunca (porque las considero productos especiales), lo que no quiere decir que las siga usando. Muchas veces las tengo también para comparar texturas de sombras, o simplemente tengo un apego emocional (sí, les juro que me pasa) y me las quedo simplemente por eso.
Con los años he notado que los productos que más rapido se ponen feos son los líquidos y los cremosos: primers, bases, iluminadores, sombras en crema. ¿Ustedes suelen darle importancia a la duración que indican las marcas? ¿hay alguien que, como yo, tenga un apego especial a ciertos productos?

FAQ DO MEU CABELO ATUALIZADO

1) Pinto meu cabelo com @ajudaleticia, especialista em ruivas de Brasília.

2) A cor que uso varia. Estou usando Keune 8.4 + 7.44 1:1 ox 30 vol, mas quando quero mais fechado uso Igora 8.1 e 8.77 (duas medidas por uma medida) ox 30 vol.

3) No retoque da raiz puxo a tinta pras pontas (veja no youtube), e se fica diferente uso tonalizantes @kamaleaocolor. Produtos pra ruiva  vendem na @belezaruivaoficial Código de desconto GLEICI.

4) Eu retoco meu cabelo com 30-45 dias. Não mais que isso para que não haja diferença de cor. No canal eu explico como faço o retoque para não manchar e economizar.

5) Eu não fiz transição capilar dessas de tirar a química, eu apenas fui estimulando cada vez mais as ondas que eram escovadas, penteadas e modeladas com coque etc. Existe stories ali fixados sobre CACHOS, onde explico como faço a finalização. Meu cabelo é 2C.

6) Meu cabelo ficou MUITO MAIS saudável usando produtos liberados, mas não sigo a risca apenas fazendo low e no poo. Atualmente o que mais uso são os produtos da @sedaoficial. 
7) Pra dormir, eu faço um rabo de cavalo bem no meio da cabeça. Você pode investir em fronhas ou toucas de cetim pra eliminar o frizz. O dayafter eu mantenho com água, creme ou um pouco de seiva da @soulpowerbrasil nos cachos mais bagunçados. Faço dedoliss e pronto!

8) Lavo meu cabelo de 4 em 4 dias (ou +) mesmo indo a academia diariamente. Meu couro cabeludo não coça e não é oleoso.

9) Meu creme pra finalizar favorito é o Power Black, junto com Óleo de Patauá @loccitaneaubresil e a seiva modeladora da Soul Power. É a mistura que nunca falha no meu cabelo, ajuda a não desbotar e dá mais brilho.

10) Pra tratamento também gosto das marcas @amend_oficial e @acquaflora. As máscaras são maravilhosas, em especial óleos egípcios e linha pós coloração. 
11) Cremes, tratamentos e acessórios vocês podem encontrar na @lojadermabox. Mesmo com Frete, sai mais barato do que em loja física. Olhem o cupom de desconto GLEICI.

12) Às vezes uso o filtro L4 do VSCO pra deixar o ruivo mais vivo. Meu celular é o S9+. Se você tem dúvidas sobre ruivo, entre no meu grupo Amor Acobreado no Facebook ♥. #cacheadas #distritofederal

¡Buenos días! 😊 El día que hicimos ronda de preguntas por stories, una de vosotras me dijo que quería que hablásemos de prebases. Como no se especificó la parte del rostro en la que aplicarlas os traigo las que tengo tanto para párpados como para rostro:
.
. 🔸Prebase de ojos de @narsissist: Smudge Proof Eyeshadows Base. A día de hoy tengo dos, la que tiene el envase más gorrinete que no tiene color y su reposición que me la dieron con color (que ya no sé si es que ya no la hacen sin tono). La segunda aún no la he estrenado pero espero que funcione igual de bien que la primera. Con ella, las sombras duran intactas horas y horas (perfectas durante todo el día). Es una verdadera pasada. No es barata pero vale lo que cuesta 😏.
🔸Prebase de ojos de @urbandecaycosmetics: Eyeshadow Primer Potion Original. Otro más que conocido por estos lares. En este caso, es una minitalla pero con una cantidad muy maja para probarla y saber si me gusta. Sólo la he probado un par de veces mas cierto es que la usé en Nochevieja y el look me duró espectacular toda la noche por lo que es una opción algo más económica a tener en cuenta. Tiene un color piel para que podamos unificar el tono del párpado 😜.
🔸Prebase para rostro de @toofaced: Hangover Rx. Ésta la tenéis reseñada en el blog con todo lujo de detalles pero, a grandes rasgos, es como una crema que aporta algo de hidratación a la vez que deja la piel muy bien acondicionada para la puesta de la base de maquillaje. Infusionada con agua de coco, probióticos y agentes revitalizantes. No contiene siliconas. Tampoco es barata, pero funciona de maravilla 😍.
.
.

Y hasta aquí puedo deciros. Mi pregunta radica en: ¿os apetece un post más explicativo en el blog, con swatches tanto con y sin prebase para ver cómo actúan (sobretodo en el caso de las prebases de ojos), precios y detalles? Espero vuestras respuestas 😉. ¿Cuáles son las que utilizáis vosotras? 😋 ¡Feliz Viernes! 😘😘😘
.
.
.

#плохаяжена 
Девочки , совет от души- не выносите мозг своим мужчинам , дайте им тоже глоток воздуха , и , поверьте, вас будут любить и ценить .

Наблюдения многолетние показали ( на основании статьи) , что счастливая женщина беззаботна . 
В дoме у неё вечно вecёлый раскардаш, на столе опрокинутая чашка выпитого кофе, книга, куча каких-то штучек, ей необходимых и усиливающих беспорядок, со стула свешивается чулочек с кружевным верхом самого неприличного цвета (второй потерян навсегда, но первый будет его ждать вечно, здесь же, до момента нахождения первого случайно, при доставании важных документов из крошечной бездонной сумочки, на глазах начальника). В доме счастливой женщины никогда нет запасов — и спутник жизни ощущает себя очень нужным и значительным, добывая всё это и понимая, что без него она, нежная и удивительная, смешливая и кудрявая, просто пропадёт. Он заботится , зарабатывает и совершенно счастлив, потому что никто его не заставляет и нет внутреннего распорядка. 
Она не cледит за ним и не хронометрирует, поэтому он трясётся над ней и страшно ревнует, хотя она практически всё время ходит по квартире в пижаме розового цвета и мало куда выходит . Готовит она быстро и вкусно, но без фанатизма, и — поэтому тоже — муж у неё, как правило, здоров и бодр.
Все говорят про неё, что она ПЛОХАЯ жена. 
У хорошей жены-хозяйки всё как в армии. В доме чистота. В шкафах всё послойно.  Во антресолях годовой запас круп на случай ядерной войны. Денежки она умеет копить, беспрерывно стирает-моет-гладит с таким фанатизмом, что невольно кажется, что это кому-то назло или чтобы забыться. Мужа кормит много, жирно и остро, потому что  в банках огурцы ведь должен же кто-то съесть). При этом муж вял, жирноват и начисто лишён возможности инициативы. Часто в такой среде мужчина не выживает, как микроб в дистиллированной воде. 
Она блюдёт мужа, как охранник, шуршит его записными книжками и идентифицирует волоски, снятые с его пиджака. И причёска у неё всегда под названием «головка в порядке», а застать её в пижаме не сможет даже ночное наводнение или пожар. Все говорят, что она ХОРОШАЯ жена и хозяйка. 
А вы - хорошая или плохая жена? 😄

⠀⠀⠀
🏷#로쉬끼블로쉬끼⠀⠀⠀
할머니만두가 개인적으로.... 양고기냄새가 너무나서 별로... 보르쉬는 김치찌개참치캔 넣은 김치찌개맛. 브런치로 가면 좋고  개인적으론 제일 별로..였지만 많이들 만족하는 곳이라고함.

I’ve had anxiety ever since I was a little girl, and I’ve never been the type to want or even choose to take a pill, no matter how bad it gets. It finally got to a point at which my hair began falling out, which I figured out was called alopecia areata. My doctor prescribed me SO MANY PILLS, y’all. They were mind-numbing, and I didn’t feel like myself. Xanax was easy, so it became my best friend every 6-8 hours, because when I took it I literally felt nothing at all. I was a zombie (but not the cool kind you see in the movies)...and it’s really difficult to perform 60-90 minute sets of music when you’re basically drugged just so you can function without completely spazzing out. I’ve been limited on my ability to experiment and see how CBD works for me, but thanks to @nutrahempcbd, I have been able to try several different products and see how they work for me. CBD is AMAZING. It does NOT make you high. It is NOT weed. It’s more of a supplement. I’ve noticed that, at least for me, it helps with my minor aches and pains from constant training and long travel days that wear your body out. More than anything, though, I have noticed it takes the edge off my anxiety - and that is priceless, because anxiety can be SO hard to live with sometimes. If you don’t have anxiety, I highly encourage you to research it to try and understand just how tough it can be. If you aren’t educated on CBD oil yet, please research it and see the amazing things it has been doing for people all over the world lately. To friends and fans with anxiety, know you are not alone. I know we don’t all publicize and openly speak about our troubles, but the worst feeling in the world is feeling alone and as if you need to censor yourself from judgement - you are never alone, and one’s judgement of you based on nothing is honestly none of your business. Good vibes and I hope this helps someone out there! ♥️🎶

caption:
¡Buenos días! 😀 La semana pasada os comentaba que tenía un brote granudo de lo más horrible. Me afectó sobretodo por la parte de la barbilla y la frente. Probé de todo: alcohol, aceite de árbol de té, mascarillas... Nada funcionaba ni para rebajar ni para mantenerlos controlados. No sé si sería estrés o causas hormonales, la cuestión es que aquello tenía que pararlo. Ya que trabajo en una farmacia, aproveché para coger un par de muestrecitas de una de las cremas para pieles acneicas que tenemos en venta denominada Emulsión Queratolítica Anti-Imperfecciones (de @bemas_dermo) y... ¡Maravilla en bote! 😍 Uno de sus ingredientes principales es el ácido salicílico, ideal para combatir las infecciones que albergan los granitos. Lo mejor es que fue un visto y no visto. Las dos primeras veces que me la apliqué, noté como rebajaba la inflamación y a los dos días ya solo me quedaron marquitas. La textura es súper agradable, te deja la piel lisita y suave, nada pegajosa. Además, posee una pequeña cantidad de pigmento pero que no colorea el rostro. Imagino que será para neutralizar la rojez producida por el grano. La cuestión, ¡me ha molado lo más grande ❤️ y la recomiendo encarecidamente para este tipo de problemas! 🤓🤓🤓 ¿Vosotras que hacéis frente a brotes de este tipo? ¡Feliz Martes! 😘😘😘

And in a family that hunted & fished, my sweet grandpa was the first one to say he didn’t want to kill any animals. He had the most tender heart & would cry if he saw any animal hurt.
He was a contractor with a perfectionist eye and built many beautiful homes for people. He always smelled like cigarette smoke, leather and cologne to me.
He built hot rods and raced them in the 50’s and told me funny stories about how’d they’d bet each other pink slips to win each other’s cars.
